title: Underlying sheaves and scalar graph of pro-etale module inverse image
statement: Let f:Y to X be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and R a sheaf of commutative rings on X_proet [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The constructed module inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], from sheaves of R-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to modules over f^{-1}R, has a natural isomorphism between its underlying abelian sheaf and abelian inverse image. Moreover, there exist a set-sheaf isomorphism eR:f^{-1}(underlying R) to underlying(f^{-1}R) and a natural set-sheaf isomorphism eM:underlying(module inverse image) to f^{-1}(underlying module), such that for every module M, set sheaf T, and sheaf maps a:T to underlying R and b,t:T to underlying M with t(x)=a(x)*b(x) for every source section x, their inverse images satisfy eM^{-1}(f^{-1}t(x))=eR(f^{-1}a(x))*eM^{-1}(f^{-1}b(x)) for every target section x of f^{-1}T. The same eR and natural eM work for all T,a,b,t. All sheaves and module carriers lie in universe u+1, with schemes in universe u.

proof.text: The abelian comparison is obtained by transporting the existing model-site underlying-module comparison through AsSmall up and down equivalences. Explicit commuting isomorphisms identify the forgotten transported module with the transported underlying abelian sheaf. Restrict the actual abelian sheaf adjunction to the model sites and use uniqueness of left adjoints to compare model inverse image with the transported actual inverse image. Compose these natural comparisons.

The scalar-graph theorem supplies the ring and natural module set comparisons with compatibility on every generalized section. Pair this result with the transported underlying abelian comparison from the first step.

theorem proEtale_moduleInverseImage_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) :
    Nonempty (proEtaleModuleInverseImage f R ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf _ ≅
          SheafOfModules.toSheaf _ ⋙ proEtaleSheafInverseImage f AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ∧
    (∃ (eR : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))).obj
            ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).obj R) ≅
            (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).obj
              ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R))
          (eM : proEtaleModuleInverseImage f R ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf _ ⋙
              sheafCompose (ProEt.topology Y) (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≅
            (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _ ⋙
              sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) ⋙
                proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))),
          ∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
              (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj R))
            (T : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (Type (u + 1)))
            (a : T ⟶ (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
              (CategoryTheory.forget CommRingCat.{u + 1})).obj R)
            (b t : T ⟶ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _ ⋙
              sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M),
            (∀ (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : T.obj.obj U),
              @id (M.val.obj U) (t.hom.app U x) =
                @id (R.obj.obj U) (a.hom.app U x) •
                  @id (M.val.obj U) (b.hom.app U x)) →
            ∀ (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
              (x : ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))).obj T).obj.obj V),
              @id (((proEtaleModuleInverseImage f R).obj M).val.obj V)
                ((eM.inv.app M).hom.app V
                  (((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))).map t).hom.app V x)) =
                @id (((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R).obj.obj V)
                  (eR.hom.hom.app V
                    (((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))).map a).hom.app V x)) •
                @id (((proEtaleModuleInverseImage f R).obj M).val.obj V)
                  ((eM.inv.app M).hom.app V
                    (((proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1))).map b).hom.app V x)))
